meta.faq.title: FAQ | Process, timelines, costs, guarantees
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Answers to the questions we hear most often before a project starts.
faq.1.a: We start with a site visit, then you receive a written proposal with quote and schedule. Execution follows with intermediate checks, and handover with a final inspection together with you.
faq.2.q: How long does a project take?
faq.2.a: It depends on size and complexity. Before we start you receive a written schedule with phases and expected timelines.
faq.3.a: We do not publish fixed prices because every space is different. After the site visit you receive a detailed quote built on the real work to be done.
faq.4.q: Can I stay at home or in the office during the works?
faq.4.a: It depends on the project. For offices and branches we plan phased or after-hours works to reduce downtime.
faq.5.a: Warranty terms, materials and workmanship are set out in writing in the proposal, so you know in advance what is included.
faq.6.q: Who do I talk to during the works?
faq.6.a: You have one point of contact from day one to handover, who coordinates the crews and keeps you updated.
faq.7.q: How do I request a site visit?
faq.7.a: Write to us on WhatsApp or by email from the Contact page, telling us the type of space, the area and what you would like to achieve.
